audit.why: 47.77% over 494 games — the largest sample of any Cassiopeia top matchup — matches the prose: he owns levels 2-3 and the first-item duel, you even it at 4-6, and the side lane stays his while teamfights are yours.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike is described without a single ability name or number — 'his E', 'Ultimate', 'his gap-closer'. The packet flags this matchup as having no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, and that is accurate.
audit.why: His clocks are Aureate Rush 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, Dreaded Return 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s, The Darkin Glaive 10/9/8/7/6s and Grim Deliverance 110/95/80s. With none of them written down, 'play far back' is the only advice the page can give.
audit.corrected: Anchored the level 2 spike to Aureate Rush's 10s, the mid game to Dreaded Return's 14s, and the late game to Grim Deliverance's 110s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer names one Zaahen ability; the full layer literally uses the placeholder 'Zaahen Ultimate' as the matchup-defining cooldown. Worse, the two abilities that actually decide the lane are absent: Aureate Rush is his only movement ability, so Miasma is a hard counter to his engage, and Dreaded Return pulls you toward him, which is lethal to a champion with no dash.
audit.why: Riot text: Aureate Rush — 'Zaahen dashes to a location and slices around himself'; Dreaded Return — 'Zaahen stabs in a direction, damaging enemies hit, then pulls them toward him'; The Darkin Glaive — 'slashes twice on his next attack, dealing bonus damage and healing himself', recastable for a knockup. Cassiopeia has no dash, blink or escape in her kit, so a pull into his melee range is the losing sequence.
audit.corrected: Named Aureate Rush, Dreaded Return, The Darkin Glaive and Grim Deliverance, made Miasma explicitly the answer to Aureate Rush rather than a generic anti-engage button, and added 'never line up with Dreaded Return'.

audit.why: The Darkin Glaive heals him on a 10s cooldown and Grim Deliverance heals for a portion of the damage it deals on 110s — poison chip without Grievous Wounds is what he is built to absorb.
audit.corrected: Added Grievous Wounds to the late-game plan and named both heals.

audit.why: Cultivation of War stacks Determination off his attacks and abilities against champions, and a full stack gives bonus AD and a revive. Kiting so he never touches you is not just damage avoidance — it denies the revive outright.
audit.corrected: Left the prose alone rather than force it into a band-limited string; recorded here so the user can place it deliberately.

edits.after: His spike — Aureate Rush (E, 10s) closes the gap before your slow ever stacks and your escapeless kit cannot disengage.

edits.after: Petrifying Gaze evens it: face his Aureate Rush and the all-in ends in a stun and a corpse.

edits.before: He forces 1v1s your escapeless kit loses — refuse the straight duel and shove from range.
edits.after: He forces 1v1s your escapeless kit loses and Dreaded Return yanks you in — shove from range.

edits.before: Open even and farming — you poke, he stays out of Twin Fang range. The cliff is level 2: his E closes the gap before your slow ever stacks and you have no escape, so play behind the wave and hoard your Q for his leap. Level 3 is worse; hug tower until 4-5, when your Q slow and stacked E damage make his approaches genuinely costly.
edits.after: Open even and farming — you poke, he stays out of Twin Fang range. The cliff is level 2: Aureate Rush (E) closes the gap on a 10s cooldown before your slow stacks, and you have no escape. Play behind the wave and hoard Miasma for that dash, not for poke — grounded, his only way in dies. Level 3 is worse; hug tower until 4-5.

edits.before: Petrifying Gaze changes the conversation at 6 — if you're facing him when he commits, his all-in ends in a stun and a corpse, so hold it exclusively for the engage. He'll force 1v1s at first item where your escapeless kit loses; refuse them, shove from range, and make every fight start with his E whiffing or his face eating Gaze.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze changes the conversation at 6 — face him when he commits and his all-in ends in a stun and a corpse, so hold it for the engage. Respect Dreaded Return (W, 14s): the pull drags an escapeless Cassiopeia into melee, so never line up with him. He forces 1v1s at first item your kit loses; refuse them and shove from range.

edits.before: He out-duels you at two-plus items and there's no pretending otherwise — but you outscale him in every fight that matters. Group, W the chokepoints, and melt his frontline with ramped E's from behind your team. If he sidelane-hunts you, concede the wave and teleport into a fight where your ult hits three.
edits.after: He out-duels you at two-plus items and there is no pretending otherwise — but you outscale him in every fight that matters. Carry Grievous Wounds: Glaive and Grim Deliverance both heal him. Group, W the chokepoints, and melt his frontline with ramped fangs from behind your team.

edits.after: Zaahen spikes at 2: Aureate Rush (E) closes the gap on a 10s cooldown before your slow stacks, and your escapeless kit cannot disengage.

edits.after: Level 3 is his — an immobile Cassiopeia has no answer to a walk-up with Aureate Rush and Dreaded Return both up. Hug your tower.

edits.before: Zaahen wins by landing Ultimate, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Zaahen wins by landing Dreaded Return, dragging your escapeless body into melee, and finishing it before your poison ramps.

edits.before: Q-poison his last-hit, E twice on the poison timer, drop W as he steps at you, and walk the grounded zone's edge while the fangs finish the math.

edits.before: Spamming E without poison until your mana bar dies — and then standing in Ultimate range with Miasma on cooldown.
edits.after: Spamming E without poison until your mana bar dies — or standing in a straight line with Dreaded Return off cooldown.

edits.before: - Zaahen Ultimate: matchup-defining — His big cooldown — punish the gap while it is down. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Miasma for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.

notes: Highest-leverage matchup in this slice by sample size (494 games) and it previously named zero Zaahen abilities — the full layer used the placeholder string 'Zaahen Ultimate' as the matchup-defining cooldown. The wants.you / wants.foe entries here are 17-23 characters, so the +/-10% band leaves about two characters of room; I could not add ability names there and left all six alone. Cultivation of War's revive is recorded in the audit but not written into prose for the same reason. Level chart conflict (champion-wide) left untouched.
